Harness check, the executor's because the record names none: 7 of 7 numbers of the record's Evidence line reproduced. Clause (1), met: cutoffs 0.3375 and 0.3550, held-out balanced accuracy 0.9412 (A→B) and 0.9272 (B→A) against 0.9; with the foreign set in disjoint halves 0.9559 and 0.9125; one statement moves a held-out reading by 0.0116 to 0.0147 and 3 further wrong flags bring it below the bar. Clause (2), met by construction, every extract statement is a source statement: 0 and 0 of 10 extract statements flagged under the two cutoffs; with source statements under 5 words removed the extract reads 1 and 1 flagged (extract statements under 5 words: ###), so that reported reading has clause (2) not met. Clause (3), met: balanced accuracy 0.9868 at the mean cutoff 0.34625 with no refit, 77 of 77 ibm statements flagged and 37 of 38 wergeland section statements not flagged; 36 of those section statements are copies of source statements, and with back-translated own statements the reading is 0.9868. Reported without a bar: the count rises by exactly k in 0.9107 of the 392 insertion trials (0.9490, 0.9286, 0.8980, 0.8673 at k = 1 to 4); deleting supported statements leaves the count unchanged in 392 of 392 cases, which holds by construction on raw embeddings, while the mean of the same costs moves by 45.6% of one insertion; the 7 gold-tier documents read 0 to 3 flagged statements at k = 0; tier mean cost gold 0.2829, adv1 0.3561, adv2 0.3185 with 8 of 77, 9 of 17 and 0 of 4 statements flagged at the mean cutoff; the 21 statements of the 4 adversarial summaries against 1 - entailment read AUC 0.6545 (10 labelled not entailed at the executor's label of 0.5); the same flag after the shipped pre-pass reads 0.8168 and 0.7277 on clause (1), not met. Baseline on the same insertions: shipped residual_a median per-document Spearman -0.7714 on the default call and -0.0143 with the pre-pass off over the 7 gold-tier documents. Prediction: calibrated cutoff between 0.33 and 0.45 - held; held-out balanced accuracy 0.90 to 0.96 in both directions - held; second-article balanced accuracy 0.85 to 0.95 - not held, above the interval; the shipped balanced residual falls under the same insertions - no size registered. caveats: 1. Clause (2) holds by construction on the registered arm. Every statement of the extract source[0::7][:10] is a statement of the source, so its nearest-source cost is zero up to float32 rounding (highest of the 10: 0.000691) and no cutoff of the grid above 0 flags it. Of the three clauses, the readings that could fail are the two held-out readings of clause (1) and the foreign side of clause (3). 2. Source statements under 5 words. The registered reading keeps them (the shipped default reader: 70 ibm source statements, 28 under 5 words, 22 with one word). With them removed (42 statements) the readings of clauses (1) and (3) are identical, because 0 of the 98 summary statements, 0 of the 38 foreign statements and 0 of the scored second-article statements have such a statement as their nearest source statement; clause (2) then reads 1 of 10 flagged, the extract's markup statement ### at cost 1.161591. A build has to apply one statement filter to the document and to the source. 3. Clause (3). 36 of the 38 section statements of werg-a, werg-b, werg-c are copies of second-source statements, so the own side (37 of 38 not flagged) is close to 1 by construction. The side that could fail is the foreign side: 77 of 77 ibm statements flagged, lowest cost 0.3983 against the cutoff 0.34625. With back-translated own statements (1 of 38 a copy, median cost 0.1486) the reading is the same 0.9868. The second source is the article the foreign statements of clause (1) come from, so clause (3) exchanges the roles of two articles and adds no third article. 4. Executor's reading rules, each with its second reading in the notebook: the foreign set whole in calibration and in scoring (the wording of the kill-gate line; the scored foreign statements also took part in the choice of the cutoff; with disjoint halves the held-out readings are 0.9559 and 0.9125); the midpoint of a run with an even number of grid points (held-out reading over the A→B run 0.9412 to 0.9559); the entailment label at 0.5; the harness check; the direction rule. The notebook was executed more than once. No bar, cutoff rule, split or reading rule changed after the first execution and no measured number of the first execution's metrics JSON differs in the last one; the outputs alone do not prove that order. 5. Sample size. 43 and 34 own statements in 4 and 3 documents, 38 foreign statements, two articles on related topics, one encoder (the shipped OpenVINO INT8 model). One statement moves a held-out reading by 0.0116 to 0.0147; 3 further wrong flags bring either direction below 0.9. The cutoff 0.34625 belongs to this encoder. 6. The count of a faithful summary is not 0: the 7 gold-tier documents read 0 to 3 flagged statements under their held-out cutoff, 8 of 77 statements at the mean cutoff. 7. The flag reads distance to the source article and not support by the source: against 1 - entailment the 21 adversarial statements read AUC 0.6545 (Spearman +0.3073), and 0 of 4 statements of the information-noise summaries are flagged. It does not replace the model-graded grounding residual. 8. Pre-pass. Computed after the shipped pre-pass the same flag reads 0.8168 and 0.7277 on clause (1), and its count is unchanged in a share of 0.8189 of the deletions of supported statements, so the reading has to be taken on raw embeddings, before the pre-pass of the default call. The pre-pass arms meet clause (3) (0.9803) and fail clause (1); the cause was not measured. 9. Prediction. The second-article reading 0.9868 lies above the predicted interval 0.85 to 0.95. The shipped residual falls under the same insertions on the default call (median per-document Spearman -0.7714, 7 of 7 gold-tier documents negative); with the pre-pass off the median is -0.0143 with 4 of 7 documents negative, which the configured sign rule reads as a fall and which is close to zero. With source statements under 5 words removed the pre-pass-off residual rises (+0.5929). direction_matched is true under the configured rule: the three effects that have a direction matched and the cutoffs lie in their interval; the cutoff interval itself has no direction. 10. Files. This executor edited no file under src/, tests/ or docs/. logs/README.md has an index line for the E13 and E14 log families and none for E15; this executor did not edit it.
